result.summary: The food delivery home screen renders mostly correctly, but one card displays a raw '€NaN delivery' value, indicating a broken price calculation or missing data. No other clear visual defects were found beyond expected carousel/viewport clipping.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery fee, exposing a failed numeric computation to the user.
issues.suggestion: Guard against undefined/null delivery fee values in the formatting logic and fall back to a sensible display such as 'Free delivery' or 'Delivery fee unavailable'; also fix the upstream data source so a numeric fee is always provided.
